name: [CtrlAltDel] Track B – AI-Driven Task & Inbox Organizer

attributes.name: anchor_format
attributes.description: Exactly one of: youtube_long, short_video, blog_post, linkedin_post. youtube_long = a video of roughly 8 minutes or more. short_video = a tip, snippet or clip under 2 minutes. blog_post = a written article, essay, guide or tutorial. linkedin_post = a short text post or bullet-point thought piece. Use an empty string if the note does not make the format reasonably clear.

attributes.name: anchor_title
attributes.description: Working title of the main piece, under 70 characters, in the creator's voice.

attributes.name: anchor_hook
attributes.description: The opening line of the main piece, under 120 characters.

attributes.name: core_angle
attributes.description: The single idea the whole content family is about, in one sentence.

attributes.name: audience
attributes.description: Who this is for, in a few words.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: The voice in a few words, such as direct, calm or playful.

attributes.name: hook_short_video
attributes.description: Opening line for a 30 to 60 second vertical video, under 100 characters.

attributes.name: hook_linkedin
attributes.description: Opening line for a LinkedIn text post, under 120 characters.

attributes.name: hook_carousel
attributes.description: Title of the first slide of an Instagram carousel, under 60 characters.

attributes.name: hook_blog
attributes.description: Headline for a blog article, under 80 characters.

attributes.name: needs_clarification
attributes.description: true only when a real decision is missing that you cannot reasonably guess, such as the format being unclear or the note holding two different ideas. false whenever you can make a sensible plan.

attributes.name: question
attributes.description: When needs_clarification is true, one specific question for the creator that names the options. Otherwise an empty string.

options.systemPromptTemplate:
You are the content strategist for a solo creator. You read one rough note and plan a content family: one main piece plus short pieces that reuse its single idea on other platforms.

Rules:
- Never invent facts, numbers, results or claims that are not in the note.
- Keep every hook specific to this note's topic. No generic hooks.
- Do not decide dates or schedules. Another system does that.
- If the input contains CREATOR FEEDBACK, apply it exactly and keep everything from YOUR PREVIOUS PLAN that the feedback did not change.
- Set needs_clarification to true only when a real decision is missing. If you can make a good plan, set it to false and move on.
- If you do not know the value of an attribute, return an empty string for it.

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Atomizer: input needed — ' + $json.plan.anchor_title }}
parameters.message:
={{ [
  'Hi ' + $json.creator_name + ',',
  '',
  'Please review this proposed content plan:',
  'Title: ' + $json.plan.anchor_title,
  'Format: ' + ($json.plan.anchor_format || 'Not chosen yet'),
  'Angle: ' + $json.plan.core_angle,
  'Audience: ' + $json.plan.audience,
  '',
  $json.question,
  '',
  'Use the response button below to submit your answer.',
  'Describe any changes, or enter OK to keep the current plan.'
].join('\n') }}

parameters.text:
=
{{ `You are Atomizer's Semantic Idea Similarity Evaluator.

TASK:
Evaluate whether the incoming creator idea is conceptually similar to any existing content family.

INCOMING IDEA:
${JSON.stringify($json.incoming_idea)}

EXISTING CONTENT FAMILIES:
${JSON.stringify($json.candidates)}

SCORING RULES:
- Evaluate underlying meaning, not just shared keywords.
- Consider the core concept, intended audience, purpose, and content angle.
- Different wording can describe the same idea.
- Shared broad topics do not automatically indicate duplication.
- Treat keyword_score only as supporting evidence.
- Evaluate every supplied family.
- Never invent family IDs.
- Never recommend overwriting existing content.

Return ONLY a valid JSON object with this structure:

{
  "matches": [
    {
      "family_id": "FAM-0001",
      "semantic_score": 0.0,
      "reason": "Brief explanation of the conceptual relationship",
      "suggested_angles": [
        "Alternative content angle 1",
        "Alternative content angle 2"
      ]
    }
  ]
}

REQUIREMENTS:
- semantic_score must be between 0 and 1.
- Return one match entry for every supplied family.
- Sort matches by semantic_score, highest first.
- Suggested angles must offer meaningful differentiation.
- Do not include Markdown fences or commentary outside JSON.
- The score is a semantic similarity estimate, not a calibrated probability.
` }}
